description: Phase 06 retrieval benchmark gold set. Relevance = a chunk contains a gold evidence quote (verbatim after case/whitespace/markdown-emphasis normalisation). Labels are independent of chunk boundaries and of the lexical re-rank's term matching. Grade 2 = primary evidence, 1 = partial/supporting. Unanswerable queries have no gold and measure the no-answer false-positive retrieval rate.
label_provenance: Claude-authored from the corpus text (2026-11-02), mechanically validated by scripts/bench_retrieval.py --validate-only. human_verified=false until the project owner reviews them.

pyq_style.workflow: PYQ bank question generation (_generate_grounded -> similarity_search, k=8)

ncert.note: Owner-supplied (Phase 06 Q1 = option b). Add chapters as {"class_name", "subject", "chapter"} and queries with corpus="ncert"; Claude does not read data/ncert/.
